about: ZIP 227 identity vectors: what an issuer key and an asset description derive to. Any wallet or explorer that shows ZSA identifiers can check itself against these. Hex is lowercase; descriptions are hashed as their exact UTF-8 bytes.

derivation.issuer: ik_encoding: 0x00 (BIP-340 algorithm byte) || 32-byte x-only key, 33 bytes
derivation.asset_desc_hash: BLAKE2b-256, personalization "ZSA-AssetDescCRH", over the description bytes
derivation.asset_digest: BLAKE2b-512, personalization "ZSA-Asset-Digest", over 0x00 (AssetId version) || issuer || asset_desc_hash

source: QED-it/orchard cf801a5d (the stack the public ZSA testnet verifies with). Values recomputed by server/crates/verify-engine tests; the two hashes were also checked with Python's hashlib.blake2b.

vectors.comment: A Cachet envelope, minted from the browser on the public ZSA testnet (confirmed at height 520).
The same description under another issuer key: same description hash, different asset.
A free-text description (not a Cachet envelope).
Non-ASCII text: hashed as UTF-8 bytes, no normalization.
